sources.citation: Rensch, Calvin R. 2012. Melanau and the Languages of Central Sarawak. SIL Electronic Survey Report 2012-011. Dallas: SIL International. 100 pp.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Comparative/lexicostatistical study built from published wordlists; Punan Batu appears only as cited forms in sec. 5 ('Other languages of Central Sarawak') and Appendix B cognate sets, drawn (App. A) from Kaboy 1965, Urquhart 1955, Ray 1913, Sandin 1980 and an unpublished Noeb list. Notes segmental reflexes for Punan Batu (final -h, *d > r/s split) but no word on stress or accent for any Punan variety; 'stress'/'accent' do not occur in the text.
